title: Cherry Cabins
description: Adds a trans-themed cabin inhabited by a unique vendor! :3
body:
![A screenshot of the cabin between some cherry trees.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/368ec8af16dcfedbe9dd4aded542d23fe63a81f6_0.webp)
Adds a cozy cabin that spawns in the Cherry Grove biomes, inhabited by a not-so-Wandering Trader. A nice little accent structure to spruce up your world!
